message: Astra: Within “Inner Monologued:”, does Ya na’s new question about the delay explain its cause, or leave that cause open? What does this draft establish, and which uncertainty deserves attention? Why would further thought about the opening earn its time over a trial revision, and what missing information would make drafting premature? What textual evidence would settle that choice? Could you give your finding and chosen next intention briefly in English, then carry out that choice?
speaker: Astra
